title: clinopodium pallidum
intro: Clinopodium pallidum, commonly known as White Calamint, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and soothe respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of White Calamint include its ability to relax the muscles, reduce anxiety, and promote a good night's sleep due to its sedative and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as borneol and camphor, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
